name: slidex
description: SlideX — an XML-based slide language and WYSIWYG editor/viewer for AI-friendly deck authoring, with pixel-true export to PPTX / PNG / PDF.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js serve examples/quickstart/deck.slx
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --arm64

author: SlideX Team
